text:
Maya (growth): quick pulse — pulled the latest performance heatmap for the new launch pages, and theres a dip in demo signups from paid channels starting 03/05. link: https://redwood.co/db/dashboards/launch-heatmap :eyes:
Raj (analytics): saw that. initial look suggests a drop in utm_source=partner_x sessions around 03/05. conversion rate fell from 3.2% -> 1.9%. raw query: `SELECT utm_source, date(day), count(*) as sessions, sum(converted) as signups FROM web.events WHERE day BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-10' GROUP BY 1,2;`
Ben (marketing ops): hmm, did we change the landing path for that partner redirect? last deploy note showed a redirect tweak. DeployBot: deploy 2026-03-05T04:12:08 completed — /partner/px -> /marketing/partner/px (301).
Cara (content): that 301 was intentional for SEO. Shouldn't break utm though. can we confirm the partner URL preserves querystring?
Raj (analytics): step one: traffic shows a big increase in sessions with empty utm_source on 03/05 for that referrer domain, so querystrings may be getting dropped. sample raw referrer header shows: `https://partner.example.com/path?ref=px` (no utm).
Alice (product): are we certain this is tracking and not an attribution window artifact? timeline aligns with deploy but want to rule out dashboard smoothing.
Maya (growth): agreed — two parallel asks: 1) make sure redirects keep utm_* intact, 2) short-term routing: if partner leads with missing utm come in, map them to SDR queue for now so we don't lose follow-ups.
Ben (marketing ops): I can add a filter in the pipeline to map `ref=px` -> utm_source=partner_x for the next 48h. will do a config change in Segment and notify.
Raj (analytics): to validate: I'll add a derived field in the dashboard to surface "inferred_partner_source" and flag rows where utm_source IS NULL but ref contains `px`. gives us quick visibility.
Cara (content): also seeing webinar signups dip among that cohort. could be messaging misalignment. I'll A/B the hero copy variant B tomorrow and link to the same redirect to test.
Maya (growth): timeline — Ben deploys mapping by EOD, Raj adds inferred flag, Cara launches hero B. we reconvene tomorrow 09:30 PT.
Alice (product): add a metric for downstream MQL rate in the dashboard so we can monitor quality, not just raw signups. can we show MQL conversion within 7 days?
Raj (analytics): yeah — adding an additional column: mql_within_7d. dashboard query will be patched. ETA 2 hours.
Ben (marketing ops): config pushed. Segment transform rule: `if (utm_source == null && query.ref == 'px') utm_source='partner_x';` deployed 2026-03-05T19:04:12. :white_check_mark:
Maya (growth): perfect. Raj, once your inferred flag is live can you post a short table here with last 7 days vs prior 7?
Raj (analytics): posted snapshot to the dashboard and pinned in the channel. TL;DR: inferred_partner_x signups recovered from 1.9% -> 2.8% after mapping, still below baseline 3.2%.
Cara (content): early CTA variant B lifted click-through on hero by +12% but landing conversion still lagging; suggests post-landing friction.
Maya (growth): action items: 1) engineering to fix redirect to preserve utm (Alice to own), 2) Ben to keep mapping for 48h, 3) Raj to monitor MQL_within_7d, 4) Cara to iterate copy and test next variant. Anyone want to add SLA on the redirect fix?
Alice (product): I'll open a ticket and tag eng-runtime; target fix by 03/07 EOD.
Ben (marketing ops): will keep mapping live until 03/09 or until traffic returns to baseline, whichever comes first.
Raj (analytics): I'll schedule an automated alert if conversion for partner_x remains >10% below baseline for more than 24h.
Maya (growth): thanks all. small note: let's treat this as a mini post-launch 'attribution hygiene' playbook update. I can draft a short checklist after we close — include redirect checks, querystring preservation, and quick inferred-source mapping.
Cara (content): +1 :memo:
DeployBot: note: previous deploy 2026-03-04 rolled back on /partner/px due to 500s; 2026-03-05 deploy replaced it.
Alice (product): can someone attach the incident link? want to understand rollback cause in case it contributed.
Raj (analytics): attaching the incident id: INC-2026-3178. shows spike in 500s from misconfigured header rewrite. might be related.
Maya (growth): thanks — we'll include that in the checklist. reconvene tomorrow 09:30 PT. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
